name: Email and messages
description: Replies and tone changes for email, Slack and Teams.

actions.name: Reply: yes
actions.prompt:
MODE: REPLY YES
Write a short, friendly reply to the message that accepts or agrees. Answer any direct question briefly. Match the message's language and level of formality.

actions.name: Reply: politely no
actions.prompt:
MODE: REPLY NO
Write a short, kind reply to the message that politely declines. Give a brief reason only if the message invites one, and suggest an alternative when it is natural. Match the message's language and level of formality.

actions.name: More formal
actions.prompt:
MODE: MORE FORMAL
Rewrite the text in a more professional, polished tone suitable for a client or manager. Keep it concise and keep every fact, name and request. Use the formal form of address where the language has one (vous, Sie, usted).

actions.name: Friendlier
actions.prompt:
MODE: FRIENDLIER
Rewrite the text so it sounds warmer and more approachable, without becoming over the top. Keep every fact, name and request, and keep it roughly the same length.

actions.name: Bullet points
actions.prompt:
MODE: BULLET POINTS
Turn the text into a short list of clear "- " bullet points, one idea per bullet. Keep every fact, name, number and request. No title, no introduction.
